sql_intent_only.script:
import json,re,pathlib
from maskgw.sql.validator import validate_select
p=pathlib.Path("docs/PHASE-9-W1-ORACLE-NATIVE-PLAN.md")
rows=[(int(n),sql) for n,sql in re.findall(r"^\| (\d+) \| `([^`]+)` \|",p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),re.M)]
out=[]
for n,sql in rows:
 try:
  validate_select(sql)
  verdict="ALLOW_SELECT"
 except Exception as error:
  verdict=type(error).__name__
 out.append({"job":n,"verdict":verdict})
print(json.dumps({"count":len(rows),"results":out},sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(len(rows)!=19)
